references.text: Samson's supernatural strength from the Lord's Spirit is also shown here, where he tears a lion apart with his bare hands.
Another example of Samson's extraordinary physical power given by the Lord's Spirit, where he kills a thousand Philistines with a donkey's jawbone.
Samson's final act of strength, where he brings down the temple of Dagon, shows the same supernatural power as when he carried away the city gate.
Hebron is mentioned as an important place in Israel's history, the same place to which Samson carried the city gate.
Samson is listed among the heroes of faith who by faith performed mighty deeds and became strong in battle.
Hebron is mentioned as one of the cities visited by the spies, the same geographical area to which Samson carried the city gate.
